content.short: Coherent focuses on providing APIs to build user-friendly DApps.
content.description: Coherent provides API-driven infrastructure that helps developers ship user-friendly DApps with fewer hurdles. The catalog is organized into three primary tiers: Build, Scale, and Enterprise. Build remains the free entry point for experimentation and learning, Scale uses a usage-based pricing model, and Enterprise offers a customized arrangement designed for larger teams and organizations. This structure lets teams start free, grow their usage as needed, and align a tailored plan with their technical and business goals.
